note: Wooded sites on both sides of Jimtown Road. The main loop's longest sites are 28-30 ft; P7-P10, by the day-use area, take 40 ft and use outhouses, with the main bathhouse open to them. Spring-fed swimming pool on Moose Brook, and a link to the Presidential Rail Trail. Limited cell service. --Claude
summary: Park page, campground map, 2026 schedule and RA per-site read: 59 sites, no hookups, no dump, showers/flush/store, 26 of 56 reservable units take 23 ft+ (40 ft on P7-P10), season 5/8-10/24 (2026), FCFS walk-ins and two non-reservable sites, $35 confirmed on RA for 2027. Not waterfront (only lean-to P6 is tagged Riverfront). Pin fine.
flags: Price discrepancy: the park page says 'Camping Rate Per Night: $29 (no hookups)' (the statewide primitive rate), but RA charges $35.00 for Standard sites on 2027 nights in June and October. Kept $35; the park page looks stale.
Rig length: 26 of 56 RA units take 23 ft+, real values (10-40 ft), all back-in. Main-loop maximum is 30 ft (022); the old note's '~30 ft' max was the main loop only.
Waterfront: not waterfront stays. Only lean-to P6 is tagged Riverfront; the camping loops sit in woods off Moose Brook.
fees.note cleared: it repeated the state:NH policy row (reservation fee, extra people, senior discount).
RA: 'There is no direct trail or road access to ATV/OHRV regional trail system from this park'. No OHV issue.
